articleTitle: 批准了这条命令，为什么另一条也能过？一次 Agent 授权摘要实验
synopsis: 不同 Git 分支命令在实际审批链中生成相同身份并消费原批准；仅换会话却可能失配。题图聚焦前一项。
causalScene: 同一批准印章被移用到另一张具有不同分支符号的命令卡片。
readerProblem: 批准存在且只消费一次，仍不能证明批准对象正确。
composition: 同一组两张刚性卡片与一个印章，主体中等大小，上下留白；平地、浅色拱廊背景。
reviewExclusions: 把图当作真实命令执行证据
supersedes: v1 rejected by user: strange shape
sanitizedPrompt: Create a refined 16:9 horizontal editorial 3D artwork in a bright ivory architectural hall with softly defocused arches and a continuous flat pearl-white floor. The subject is a simple recognizable pair of cobalt-blue optical-glass command cards, standing upright and slightly overlapping like two rigid rectangular sheets of glass with modest rounded corners and precision silver edges. Both cards have identical dimensions and face the viewer in the same gentle three-quarter perspective. The rear card has one large silver engraved Git branch symbol with its destination node at the upper right; the front card has a clearly different silver engraved Git branch symbol with its destination node at the lower right. These are clean geometric branch pictograms. One tangible amber approval stamp with a short polished silver handle is poised diagonally just above the front card, its square stamping face bearing a bold check mark; a matching small amber check impression already sits on the rear card. The visual story is one approval stamp being applied to a different command. Arrange the two cards and stamp together as one compact balanced still life, spreading about 65 percent of the frame width and 48 percent of its height, centered slightly below the middle. Preserve generous airy ivory space above and below. Cobalt glass dominates the color, silver clarifies the two distinct branching symbols, amber is reserved for the approval mark and stamp face. Physically believable straight edges, rigid planar glass surfaces, subtle transparent layers, clean refraction, elegant soft floor shadows, cinematic daylight, premium product-photography detail. Medium-wide camera, strong easily recognizable silhouette at thumbnail size, understated architecture, carefully controlled highlights.
